newsitem.title: GREECE: Alpha, Sigma top Greek brokers May market shares.
newsitem.headline: Alpha, Sigma top Greek brokers May market shares.

text.p: May trading volume at the Athens stock exchange surged to 1.16 trillion drachmas, doubling from April's 592 billion, the exchange's members association (SMEHA) said.
Sigma Securities closed in on Alpha Brokerage with its market share jumping to 8.52 percent from 6.7 in April, a touch below Alpha's 8.94 percent.
The top runners were followed by National Securities, Telesis Securities and N. Devletoglou -- their rankings unchanged from the previous month.
Kappa Securities jumped to 10th place from 15th in April, capturing 2.74 percent of the month's trading volume.

Cumulative January-to-May trading volume, boosted by May's strong business, reached 3.69 trillion drachmas -- an impressive improvement over 1996 when the entire year's volume was 2.53 trillion drachmas.
In the first five months of the year it was still Alpha Brokerage and Sigma Securities battling it out for the lead, their cumulative market shares at 8.35 and 7.69 percent respectively.
SMEHA released the following data and market share rankings for May. The top 15 brokers shared 59 percent of the bourse's trading volume. The remainder went to the exchange's other 45 member brokers.
